_meta: A two-phase commit timeline. The coordinator sends PREPARE; each participant votes YES and enters the PREPARED state, holding its locks; the coordinator logs the COMMIT decision once all vote yes; then it delivers the decision to each participant, which finally commits and releases locks. A participant is in its WINDOW OF UNCERTAINTY from the moment it votes YES until the moment it learns the decision: during that window it has promised it can commit (so it may not unilaterally abort) but does not know whether the others agreed (so it may not unilaterally commit) — it can only wait. If the coordinator crashes while a participant is in that window, the participant BLOCKS, holding its locks, until the coordinator recovers. Times are logical ticks. crash_times is the sweep of coordinator-crash moments to test.
